title: The Long Road to Bethlehem
paragraphs: The emperor far away in Rome decided to count everyone in his empire, and everyone had to go to their family town to be counted. Joseph's family came from Bethlehem, David's town, so Joseph and Mary had to travel about eighty miles from Nazareth. On foot, or perhaps with a donkey, over rough hills, with Mary's baby due very soon. It is a long, tiring road. The emperor thought he was in charge, and was moving everyone like pieces on a board. But in the story, God was using even this to bring the promise to the right town at the right time. Micah's tiny Bethlehem was getting closer.
wonder: I wonder what Mary and Joseph talked about on the long road?
activity: Go for a walk together, counting steps or landmarks, and have a snack at the "halfway".
prayer: God of every journey, bless all who are travelling today, especially those who travel with little. Amen.
alt: A couple and a donkey climb a hill road towards a small town under a star, the road shining like gold thread.
translation: Retold in our own words, following the World English Bible.
